content.short: OKX DEX is a leading swap aggregator integrated into OKX Wallet offering trading across 30+ chains including Mantle with zero fees on many pairs.
content.description: OKX DEX is the decentralized trading infrastructure of the OKX ecosystem, integrated natively into OKX Wallet and connecting to vast liquidity pools spanning more than 30 blockchain networks. Users benefit from zero-fee trading on many pairs while accessing the best prices through intelligent routing across hundreds of DEXes simultaneously. OKX DEX is deployed on Mantle, giving Mantle users access to OKX's institutional-grade liquidity network through a fully non-custodial interface.
